MEET YONDR, A COMPLETE FULL-DAY PHONE-FREE SCHOOL SOLUTION

Since 2014, Yondr has led the charge to create phone-free spaces, supporting millions of pupils around the world with patented pouch technology, tailored training, and ongoing support.

With the Yondr Phone-Free Schools Program, teachers no longer have to manage phone use, and pupils get a much-needed break from digital distractions. They simply place their wearable technology into a lockable pouch upon arrival at school and stow it in their school bag. At the end of the school day, pupils unlock the pouch and regain use of their device.

IT'S NOT A MOMENT, IT'S A MOVEMENT

With widespread phone-free policy adoption in leading districts becoming the norm, Yondr is uniquely positioned to help you fuel pupils’ focus, learning, and well-being during this school year and beyond.
